senses.gloss:
प्लक्ष plakṣá, m. wavy-leaved fig-tree (Ficus 🞄infectoria): (a) -prasravaṇa, -rāja, m. 🞄N. of a locality where the Sarasvatī rises;
 🞄-sravaṇa, n. id..
प्लाक्ष plā́kṣa, a. relating or belonging to 🞄the wavy-leaved fig-tree (Ficus infectoria).

प्लववत् plava-vat, ad. as with a boat;
 a. 🞄possessing a boat.

प्लवित plav-ita, (pp.) n. swimming or leaping;
 🞄-itṛ, m. one who leaps (with g. of 🞄distance).
प्लात plāta, m. pat. son of Plati.
प्लाय pla‿aya, Ⅰ. Ā. (= pra‿aya) go away (V.).
प्लाशि plāśí, m. sg. & pl. one of the intestines.
प्लाशुक plā́śu-ka, a. [= pra‿āśu-ka] rapidly 🞄growing up again.
